stem: The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(15)$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write down an expression in terms of e for $\text{P}(X = 12)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: It is given that $\text{P}(X = n) = \text{P}(X = n + 1)$.
parts.text: Write down an equation in $n$, and hence find the value of $n$.
